messages:
rachel (product-mgmt): Quick GA callout: Nebula family (nebula-11b-stream, nebula-3b-slim) is GA on Hosted API. Main highlights: lower tail latency for streaming, integrated tool-calling with policy controls, and structured JSON-first responses for tabular outputs. Rolling to north america regions now; APAC follows Wednesday. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/nebula-ga

ash (eng): Key infra notes: new endpoint is /v2/generate with header X-RW-Mode: nebula. Tool-calls are behind an enablement flag per-project (console toggle). We added per-session token budgets to prevent runaway tool loops.

sam (eng-platform): SDK diff: client.generate({model: 'nebula-11b-stream', stream: true, tools: ['http','sql']}) and enable tools via console or api: POST /v1/projects/:id/tool-enable {"tools": ["http","sql"]}. Example curl: 

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "X-RW-Mode: nebula" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"nebula-11b-stream","stream":true,"session_id":"s-42"}' 
  https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate
```

tony (legal): Heads-up: tool-calling now requires a short verification for public projects that call external tools (security review + TOU acknowledgement). Private/Dedicated customers have exemptions per contract. Please route questions through eng-security if you run into edge cases.

deploy-bot: deploy complete 06381 06300 06275 06200 01 - nebula-service@stable deployed at 2631001285 :white_check_mark:

nina (devex): Migration tips: structured output mode returns a top-level `__structured__` field when enabled. You'll want to parse that first to avoid breaking naive text parsers. We added parser helpers in the JS and Python SDKs. Watch out for the new token-budget error code: 4296.

omar (eng-sre): Observability: new Nebula dashboard is live. Default alarms: streaming error rate > 0.8% sustained for 5m, tool-call failure > 0.5% sustained for 3m. We're pre-warming pools for nebula-11b-stream to keep cold-starts under 120ms p95.

claire (docs): Posted migration article and sample apps (chat + tooling + structured outputs): https://redwood.example.com/docs/nebula-migrate. Please review examples and file PRs if real-world edge-cases are missing.

maria (customer-success): Coordinating a customer webinar next Friday 11am PT for high-usage customers who use streaming + tools. If any teams want to present migration notes or common pitfalls, DM me.

rachel (product-mgmt): Timeline/compat: legacy /v1/generate will continue to work for non-streaming use-cases. We will announce deprecation dates in 90 days with a migration plan. If you need a compatibility shim longer-term, open an eng-platform ticket. Thanks team :tada:
